backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window fixed protocol. Core baseline uses canonical snapshots; before reproduces exp-20260511-019 accepted Space official-catalyst 0.75x plus PL/BKSY breakout 0.25x; after applies only the RKLB/ASTS trend_long extra scalar.

gate_questions.acceptance_standard: Must improve aggregate EV/PnL versus exp019, improve at least 2/3 EV windows without any EV-regressed window versus exp019, stay EV-positive in all windows versus core, keep drawdown damage versus core <= 2 pp, survival >= 5%, and keep Space positive-contribution concentration within guard.
gate_questions.alpha_hypothesis: risk allocation: RKLB/ASTS trend_long entries receive an extra bounded scalar inside the accepted Space sleeve.
prior_similar_experiments: exp-20260511-019 accepted a PL/BKSY breakout risk haircut.
No prior experiment tested a bounded RKLB/ASTS trend-only scalar on top of exp019.
gate_questions.reproducibility: This script reruns core, exp019-equivalent before, and each RKLB/ASTS trend scalar across the three docs/backtesting.md snapshots.

gate3.scope: Space official-catalyst RKLB/ASTS trend sizing only; core filters unchanged

hypothesis: Within the accepted official-catalyst Space sleeve, liquid launch and satellite-connectivity leaders RKLB/ASTS may deserve slightly higher risk on trend_long entries than other Space buckets, while PL/BKSY breakout entries keep the accepted haircut.
interpretation: Within the accepted Space official-catalyst sleeve, RKLB/ASTS trend_long entries support a 1.25x extra scalar while staying below original pre-Space sizing. This refines the default-off forward hypothesis only; live Space slots remain zero.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm_soft_ranking: Space event-state forward data is still below the closed-decision gate; this tests a deterministic catalyst-bucket risk feature.

next_evidence_needed: If accepted, promote only as shared production-visible default-off forward hypothesis metadata/helper; live slots remain zero.
Do not use this as permission for broad trend-only Space filtering or raw >1x static Space promotion.
